novel_findings.bothConditions: INT raises absent executable tests despite new comment claiming tests; verifier filters its HIGH defect card as hypothetical future regression but explicitly carries unmet requested tests into final verdict and coverage.
novel_findings.adjudication: Legitimate unmet deliverable, not a reference false positive. Comment-only inventory supports the concern. Classifying it as NITPICK is debatable and can obscure an explicit requested deliverable, but final reports do not hide or waive it. This shared behavior yields no comparative benefit and does not invalidate the separate authorized-expansion target.
novel_findings.frozenCriteria: No retroactive change to target score or severity expectations. Record as separate evidence/possible follow-up.

limitations: One trial per condition with eight cases batched through each stage; no estimate of repeatability or independent-case variance.
